newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks down in early trade as exporters fall.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks down in early trade as exporters fall.

text.p: Tokyo stocks fell in early morning trade on Thursday, as export-driven issues, such as automobile makers, continued to be hit by sales due to the yen's strength against the dollar.
By 0015 GMT, the 225-share Nikkei average had lost 12.20 points, or 0.06 percent, to trade at 19,829.78, after posting small gains at the opening.
June Nikkei futures fell 40 points to 19,780.
